name: scroll_expander_semi_empirical
title: Scroll expander semi-empirical model
summary: Semi-empirical positive-displacement (scroll) expander: supply throttling and wall heat transfer, isentropic expansion to the built-in (adapted) pressure followed by an isochoric expansion to the exhaust pressure, leakage flow, exhaust wall heat transfer, mechanical losses and global isentropic effectiveness. Originally written as an EES MODULE; the equations are flattened into the main program (library decision D10).

origin.course: ULiège laboratory component model (2008), reused in ORC cycle models

verification.reference: EES solution report shipped with the original file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/expander_module.tex, main-program variables). The variable records decoded from the binary .EES are stale (mixed older runs) and were not used; see gap CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE
verification.notes: 21 common variables: the 17 fixed inputs agree exactly; 4 computed outputs differ: M_dot_r_exp 0.12 %, epsilon_s_exp 0.20 %, W_dot_sh_exp 1.36 %, t_r_ex_exp 1.91 % (EES report values rounded to 4-5 significant digits), attributed to R123 property differences between EES 9.920 and CoolProp (ees_import.md §11, older EES fluid models: up to a few %).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/expander_module.eescode (equation-identical transcription of the original, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip: EES_ok/expander_module.EES with its residuals window dump and LaTeX solution report (verification reference)

history.action: added (roadmap card C-39, batch B-02; first application of decision D10, MODULE flattened)
